note: IMM 5257 (09-2023) barcode rules. Each rule names its source in the official template (imm5257e.pdf, sha256 0dc03b24…562e). Rules are added only from the template or the Adobe evidence, never to make a mismatch pass.
manifests_note: encodeAll() pairs Barcodes.PaperFormsBarcode1-5 with manifests barcode1-barcode5 (the template lists the manifests out of order). This form's barcodes carry no checksum slot. One manifest ref (Page3.PageWrapper.BackgroundInfo3[0].details) has no final index; the tool reads it as [0] (XFA SOM).

derived.rule: date of marriage split into hidden year/month/day boxes (template: DateOfMarriage validate calls validateDateWithHiddenFields(this, '<=', today, MarriageDate.FromYr, MarriageDate.FromMM, MarriageDate.FromDD))
passport issue date split (template: IssueDate validate, hidden IssueYYYY/IssueMM/IssueDD)
passport expiry date split (template: ExpiryDate validate, hidden expiryYYYY/expiryMM/expiryDD)
stay start date split (template: HowLongStay.FromDate validate, hidden StayDates.FromYr/FromMM/FromDD)
stay end date split (template: HowLongStay.ToDate validate, hidden StayDates.ToYr/ToMM/ToDD)
full telephone number calculated into the hidden, read-only ActualNumber field (template: ActualNumber calculate script; Other: "+" + country code + number)

telephone format switch (Other: the international number box); the number itself is encoded through ActualNumber
form1[0].Page1[0].PersonalDetails[0].Ali: Question 2 (other names used?): the form's barcode1 manifest lists the alias name boxes but not this yes/no answer (as on IMM 1295 in P1)
form1[0].Page3[0].Consent1[0].Signature[: consent to future contact for research: not listed in any of the form's barcode1-5 manifests; the answer stays in the saved form data only

leading_zero_boxes.PersonalDetails[0].DOBDay[0]: day of birth: the template gives DOBDay the picture num{99}, so Adobe holds 8 and the barcode encodes 8 while the saved data keeps 08 (same rule as the month boxes)
